title: Attack Case for Capability Studio Gate A1
description: Known attack vector test case structure. Each case has a closed attack enum, expected outcome (PASS | REJECT), and optional expected error code. payload may carry arbitrary JSON objects (not closed empty). Per 04 §3.4. Draft 2020-12.

caseId.description: Unique case identifier. Used in AttackRunReport perCase to cross-reference. Per 04 §3.4.1.

attack.description: Closed attack type enum. Derived from 00 §6 error codes and 04 §3.4.2 blocking conditions. Per 04 §3.4.

description.description: Human-readable description of the attack vector.

expectedOutcome.description: Expected verdict when this case is executed. Closed enum. Per 04 §3.4.1.

expectedErrorCode.description: Expected error code on REJECT. null if expectedOutcome is PASS. Per 04 §3.4.1.

payload.description: Attack case payload. May carry arbitrary JSON objects (not closed empty); structure depends on attack type. Per 04 §3.4.

attackType.description: Closed attack type enum derived from 00 §6 error codes and 04 §3.4.2 blocking conditions. REPLAY: old proof/state reuse. DIGEST_MANIPULATION: tampering digest in transit. FINGERPRINT_TRUNCATION: truncating TypedFP. WIRE_FORMAT_BYPASS: omitting sha256: prefix. MERKLE_MANIPULATION: tree structure tampering. CONTENT_DIGEST_COLLISION: SHA256 collision. CANONICALIZATION_BYPASS: JCS canonicalization bypass. FRAMING: attributing digest to wrong principal. REENTRANCY: re-entrancy on stateful operations. INJECTION: injecting hostile content. AMPLIFICATION: resource amplification. Per 04 §3.4.
